scope: Frozen eggcc Pass 3 executed by the standalone Cell CPU. Release binary for timings. Separate slot-transfer-audit build for counts and pre-apply SHA-256.
release_order: One warm-up per mode. In each pair of measured blocks, reverse the order. Rotate by three modes before each new block pair. Fresh Rust process per sample.
timing_note: One Raytrace parent-owned block 3 invocation ran out of space writing output. It was excluded and the same block position was rerun before block 4.
sampled_cost_note: Separate audit build. Every 127th outermost call per region, starting at call 64. Net mean ns = (elapsed_ns - empty_clock_ns) / samples. Scale by calls for a local region estimate. Replay rows only record sampled calls. No sample time is part of the release timings.
